skill.name: notion-api
skill.description: Provides structured guidance for using the Notion REST API with curl, jq, and JSON payloads. It covers authentication, endpoints, pagination, errors, block types, properties, filters, sorts, and rich text.
skill.summary: Use Notion API endpoints safely with ready reference patterns for pages, databases, blocks, comments, and rich text.
skill.author: intellectronica

content.value_statement: Notion API tasks require exact endpoints, headers, and JSON shapes. This skill gives practical request patterns and safety guidance for workspace automation.
actual_capabilities: Build curl requests with required Notion headers.
Retrieve, create, update, and archive pages.
Query databases with filters, sorts, and pagination.
Work with blocks, comments, users, and data sources.
Reference property, block, and rich text formats.
Apply confirmation guidance for destructive changes.
limitations: Requires a valid Notion integration token and workspace access.
Cannot bypass Notion permission or sharing rules.
Does not provide a packaged SDK or reusable client library.
API examples must be adapted to the user schema and IDs.

use_cases.title: Manage Project Databases
use_cases.description: Create pages, update project databases, and review workspace content through approved Notion API calls.

use_cases.title: Prototype Integrations
use_cases.description: Test Notion REST requests with curl before moving logic into a service or app.

use_cases.title: Standardize Operations Updates
use_cases.description: Query task databases, collect comments, and standardize page updates with repeatable request patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the notion-api skill to search my Notion workspace for pages about quarterly planning. Show the matching titles and links.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the notion-api skill to draft a request for creating a Notion page under this parent page ID: <parent_page_id>. Ask before sending it.

prompt_templates.title: Query a Database
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the notion-api skill to query this database ID with Status equal to Done and Due Date after 2026-01-01. Include pagination handling.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the notion-api skill to plan a safe batch update for moving selected pages into a new database schema. Include confirmations and rollback notes.

output_examples.input: Search the workspace for pages about onboarding.
output_examples.output: A concise list of matching pages, IDs, last edited dates, and direct Notion links.

output_examples.input: Create a project page under a parent page.
output_examples.output: A confirmation request describing the page title, parent, and initial blocks before any API call is sent.

output_examples.input: Query a tasks database for open items.
output_examples.output: A filtered task summary with item names, owners, due dates, and a note when more pages require pagination.

best_practices: Keep Notion tokens in environment variables or approved secret storage.
Confirm changes before creating, updating, archiving, or deleting workspace content.
Retrieve current page or database state before applying updates.
anti_patterns: Do not paste Notion tokens into shared logs, tickets, or transcripts.
Do not run bulk updates without checking rate limits and pagination.
Do not assume property names are stable when property IDs are available.

faq.question: Does this skill need a Notion API token?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs a valid integration token with access to the target workspace content.

faq.question: Can it delete pages or blocks?
faq.answer: It can guide archive and delete requests, but users should confirm every destructive operation first.

faq.question: Does it include a Notion SDK?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on REST calls, curl examples, JSON payload guidance, and API behavior.

faq.question: Can it read private workspace content?
faq.answer: Only content shared with the integration token can be accessed through the Notion API.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it handle pagination?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains cursors, has_more handling, page_size, and repeated requests until results are complete.
